trap.label: responder por
trap.wrong: Executives must respond for the decision.
trap.right: Executives must account for the decision.
trap.why: “Responder por” leva o aluno a respond for. Em inglês, ser responsável perante alguém é account for (ou answer for); respond é “reagir”.

mcq.q: “The fall in morale was hard to ___.”

opts: Two departments explain on most losses.
Two departments account for most losses.

mcq.q: “Executives must account for the decision” means they must...

fix.wrong: Sales account the half of our income.
fix.right: Sales account for half of our income.

fix.wrong: The board chairman cannot account of the delay.
fix.right: The board chairman cannot account for the delay.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva na passiva: “Nobody can account for the loss.”
rewrite.answer: The loss cannot be accounted for.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com account for: “Two departments make up most of the cost.”
rewrite.answer: Two departments account for most of the cost.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com account for: “How do you explain the fall in morale?”
rewrite.answer: How do you account for the fall in morale?
